about_company_intro: Green Rich (Jinruizhi) is a consumables brand company founded in 1997, specializing in the R&D, manufacturing and sales of OPC drums for photocopiers. The company owns two well-known brands — Green Rich (Jinruizhi) and Hongmi — renowned in the industry for high quality and excellent value. Green Rich is committed to delivering outstanding print experiences through precision engineering and premium materials, ensuring clarity and durability in every printout. Serving both home users and enterprise clients, Green Rich offers a broad product range covering various copier drum models and specifications to meet diverse needs. The Hongmi brand focuses on the OPC drum sector, providing high-performance solutions. Hongmi drums are praised for their exceptional performance and reliability, guaranteeing high-quality copy output in offices, schools, and other environments. With years of professional experience and technical expertise in the OPC drum field, Green Rich (Jinruizhi) continues to drive industry development and innovation.
